inspector.title: Protocol Inspector
inspector.raw_command_placeholder: Type a raw protocol command (e.g. LIST|path)
inspector.proto_explain_hint_default: Click a command to see its explanation.
inspector.empty_console: Connect and perform an action to see raw protocol traffic.
inspector.proto_explain_unknown: No explanation available for this selection.
inspector.proto_explain_hello: Handshake: negotiates the protocol version before anything else can happen.
inspector.proto_explain_auth: Authentication: sends credentials. Educational note — this protocol sends them in plaintext.
inspector.proto_explain_list: Directory Listing: asks the server for the files in the current path.
inspector.proto_explain_upload: Upload Request: tells the server to prepare for an incoming byte stream.
inspector.proto_explain_download: Download Request: asks the server to start streaming a file's bytes.
inspector.proto_explain_mkdir: Make Directory: creates a new folder inside the user's sandbox.
inspector.proto_explain_delete: Delete: removes a file or folder from the server.
inspector.proto_explain_rename: Rename: changes a file or folder's name in place.
inspector.proto_explain_move: Move: relocates a file into a different directory.
inspector.proto_explain_quit: Disconnect: politely closes the connection before the socket drops.
inspector.proto_explain_ping: Latency Probe: round-trips a tiny message to measure network delay (RTT).
inspector.proto_explain_tls: Encrypted Payload: the application-layer command is no longer visible because it was encrypted by TLS.

missions.title: Interactive Guided Challenges
missions.subtitle: Complete core networking tasks to verify protocol behavior and defenses.
missions.m1_desc: Initiate connection and complete the HELLO handshake to receive server banner 220.
missions.m1_hint: Click Connect or inject raw 'HELLO|CS4S/2.0' in the inspector.
missions.m2_desc: Authenticate using valid client credentials to receive 230 AUTH_OK.
missions.m2_hint: Log in via the connection panel or inject 'AUTH|admin|admin123'.
missions.m3_desc: Inject an invalid or malformed command into the TCP stream to observe the server's 400 validation error.
missions.m3_hint: Use the Send Raw input in the inspector to transmit a garbage command, e.g. 'CORRUPT_CMD'.
missions.m4_desc: Attempt a Path Traversal attack by requesting a file outside the sandbox root and verify the 403 rejection.
missions.m5_title: 5. Rate Limiting Resilience (429 Too Many Requests)
missions.m5_desc: Trigger the server's flood/brute-force defense by rapidly bursting commands or failed logins until receiving 429.
missions.m5_hint: Send rapid failed AUTH commands or burst requests until the rate limiter triggers.
missions.m6_desc: Establish an encrypted session with TLS enabled and observe payload confidentiality.
missions.m6_hint: Check 'Enable TLS' on both server and client, then connect.

udp.title: Connectionless UDP Datagram Channel
udp.subtitle: Compare performance, latency, and reliability between TCP streams and UDP datagrams.
udp.status_completed: Completed: {received}/{total} datagrams received ({loss}% loss, avg {latency} ms).
udp.concept_note: Educational Insight: TCP guarantees 100% delivery via retransmission at the cost of latency. UDP delivers instantly with zero handshake, but dropped packets are lost permanently.
